newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's parliament approves five tax bills.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's parliament approves five tax bills.

text.p: Indonesia's parliament approved five tax bills on Thursday aimed at strengthening state and provincial revenues, the government said.

Parliament unanimously approved draft bills on local taxes and levies, taxes on the transfer of land and buildings, on the issue of warrants against tax offenders, on tax courts and on non-tax revenues, Finance Ministry officials said.
Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad told parliament that state revenues would be strengthened following the approvals of taxes on the transfer of land and buildings.
"The approvals of local taxes and levies would give a legal foundation for municipal revenues," Mar'ie said.
He said the bills on warrants against tax offenders and on tax courts were aimed at upholding tax laws.
